patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Price previously declined from ~1900 to ~1725 with lower highs and lower lows. Since the ~1725 low, price has formed higher lows and broken above swing highs near 1800 and 1825, indicating a structural shift from bearish to bullish.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: A strong impulsive green candle around 14:00 drove price from approximately 1790 to 1840. Price is now consolidating in a narrow range near the highs, forming the early stages of a bullish flag.

patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three swing lows are visible: a left shoulder near 1775, a lower head near 1725, and a right shoulder near 1780-1800. Price has advanced above the connecting neckline area around 1800-1825.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price shifted from downtrend to uptrend structure after the ~1725 low, forming higher highs and higher lows. Recent impulsive move to ~1840 followed by consolidation near highs suggests bullish continuation potential.
